html:
SMTO-MEM-0010 — The agent hasn't finished saving what you asked it to remember

GUID: c64cd7a6-0bbe-5571-bec4-2a23f6cacf17
Slug: memory-epoch-publication-required
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: memory

What happened

  • You asked the agent to save everything it learned, but it tried to finish before completing that save. SMTO didn't accept the task as finished yet.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let the task keep running; the agent is told to finish saving the lessons before it can complete. SMTO won't mark the task done until the save you asked for is complete.
  2. If the task stops or waits for you, reply asking it to save what it learned to memory and to say which parts it couldn't cover. The agent may report a partial save when it can't review everything, which lets the task finish honestly.
  3. Open the Memory Editor and select Refresh to see which lessons were already saved before asking for any to be saved again. Checking first avoids saving the same lessons twice.

What success looks like

  • The task finishes, and the saved lessons appear in the Memory Editor's Memories list.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't ask the agent to redo work it already finished to get past this; only the memory save is missing.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Task completion was rejected (memory_epoch_publication_required) because the user explicitly asked to save an epoch's lessons and that memory epoch publication is not yet complete.

What this means

  • An explicitly requested memory-epoch publication has not completed. The classification describes only the condition observed by the producer.

Why this can happen

  • An explicit existing publication obligation is incomplete.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the retained operation, condition and effect evidence before choosing a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • The agent must review the requested task-context epoch, save its lessons with memory.put and publish the epoch manifest with memory.publish_epoch, reporting partial completion if source coverage is unavailable. Inspect memory_epoch_request in the run state; the gate is require_persistence in src/agent_runtime/skills/memory/diagnostics.py.
  • Review the requested epoch, save its lessons and publish its manifest; report partial completion if required coverage is unavailable.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the reported condition first; existing effect evidence and replay checks still decide whether a new attempt is permitted.

How to verify the fix

  • The reported prerequisite is satisfied and a new authorized operation returns its actual result.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a write whose external effect is still unknown.

Technical notes

  • Diagnostic presentation does not start recovery or alter authorization.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
